blocks.text: Cloud storage saves data on remote servers instead of local devices, so it can be reached from anywhere and shared easily. Google Drive and Dropbox let users store and share files online, and businesses keep backups in the cloud so data survive local hardware failures.

blocks.prompt: Why is a cloud backup safer than a backup on the same computer?
blocks.explanation: If the computer is lost, stolen or broken, a backup stored on it is lost too, while the cloud copy remains on remote servers.

items: Cloud storage: files on remote servers, reachable anywhere; safe backups (Google Drive, Dropbox).
